notes: v2.9.31: arrow reliability is hardened for Hero/Kiwoom comparison. Date-level diagnostics now expose EMA112/224/448, BB40/2.2 cross, EMA crosses, SAR condition, volume EMA40 and EMA224 disparity behind the four raw formulas. Watermelon EMA112/224/448 is also unified with the same Hero-style cumulative EAVG used by the visible chart and arrow formulas. This is especially important for corporate-action stocks such as Signetics after its 5:1 share consolidation. Trading strategy, Bowl-3, accumulation and live-order rules remain unchanged.
